item.title: Confessional 1.5.1
item.description:
• The chat box grows as you type and uses its full width (Return sends, Shift-Return for a new line)
  • Summaries, transcripts, notes and chat use the whole window; bigger screenshots

item.title: Confessional 1.5.0
item.description:
• Chat with your meetings: a Chat window for all your meetings and a Chat tab in each one, with follow-ups and clickable sources
  • Any AI provider: OpenAI, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Z.ai (GLM), xAI (Grok), Mistral, Groq, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible service
  • Summaries and chat can each use a different model; private meetings still only use your private model
  • A redesigned Settings window with a sidebar and search
  • Settings → Calendar has a shortcut for adding your Google account (Internet Accounts)

item.title: Confessional 1.4.0
item.description:
• Floating call controls that stay on top during a call
  • Warnings during the call if the call audio or your mic goes silent
  • Google Meet: matched to your calendar by its link, stops when you close the tab, optional Google sign-in for exact names
  • Optional: record calendar meetings automatically
  • Timeline with talk time, stars, notes and screenshots under each meeting
  • Search shows the matching lines; Highlights collects every starred moment
  • Right-click to copy a quote, a link to the moment, or save an audio clip
  • Keyboard: space, arrows, Cmd-1/2/3
  • Storage settings, Send Feedback, a sample meeting, and What's new
  • If the graphics memory is full (e.g. a big local AI model), transcription falls back to the Neural Engine

item.title: Confessional 1.3.1
item.description:
• First update through the new updater
  • Small fix in follow-up email drafting

item.title: Confessional 1.3.0
item.description:
• Updates itself: checks daily, installs with one click, never mid-recording
  • Today view and Record & Join from your calendar
  • Free-form notes per meeting, editable call notes, tags, and faster search
  • Ask your meetings, follow-up emails, Reminders, weekly digest
  • Optional local AI model, and per-meeting Keep on this Mac
